label: KarooTopoMaps
description: Custom high-contrast topographic map styles for Hammerhead Karoo devices. Switch between 9 handcrafted map styles directly on your Karoo.
releaseNotes: v1.0.0: Initial release with standalone companion app, 9 handcrafted map styles (Official IGN, Earth & Gravel, High-Visibility DEM, Trail Territory, Vintage Explorer, Granite Altiplano, Tactical Dark Mode, Elevate MTB, ALT-MTB Special), and multilingual support.
